coaching.headline: Legion and Renna won it from 9.7 on; before that, five deaths before minute 8 gave away the Fangtooth.
coaching.team: We won this with the carry and mid, after an opening that handed the other side everything. Five deaths before minute 8: three of them in a coin-flip fight at midmap at 3.7 with no objective up, then Yin and Phase two-man against Bayle at their Fangtooth at 7.1. Fangtooth went to them at 8 and Mini Prime at 13. From 9.7 Legion killed Kira six times and Renna killed Howitzer three, and the fight at Fangtooth at 14.5, won 5-0, turned the map: Fangtooth, two outer towers, then the Genesis Core at 24. We won 11 fights and cashed seven. The one late miss was Orb Prime at 27: nobody was dead, we were winning 3-0 across the map, and it went uncontested. Primal Fangtooth at 28 and the fight at 28.9, won 4-2, ended it. Next game: the first Fangtooth is a five-man decision; two-man is a donation.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The fight at Fangtooth at 14.5, won 5-0 with Legion and Yin taking two kills each. Fangtooth and an outer tower followed inside a minute, and from there we won eight of the next nine fights. Before it the map was theirs: Fangtooth and Mini Prime both conceded.
coaching.whatWorked: The duo. Legion had 15 kills on two deaths, and Phase was in on 29 of our 38 kills with 26,199 healing, the most in the game.

perPlayer.219ccde6-c9e2-4a6e-900c-65304c72c960: Yin fed the early map and paid it back on objectives. First blood on Howitzer at 1.2, then three deaths before minute 11, two to Bayle, with the one at 7.1 handing over the Fangtooth. From there 32,850 damage to objectives and two kills in the fight at 14.5, won 5-0. One ward all game, no armor against four physical damage dealers.
perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Phase carried the support job. In on 29 of our 38 kills, 26,199 healing and 12 wards, all the most in the game. Two deaths before minute 10, in the coin-flip at 3.7 and at their Fangtooth at 7.3, the second right before the conceded Fangtooth.
perPlayer.29199160-1218-49ea-9f15-0717d1726afb: Legion won the carry lane the read said was lost. Fifteen kills, two deaths, 37,515 damage to heroes, and Kira killed six times on her way to 3-8-4. Off the core with Vanquisher and Tainted Rounds, no Malady or Deathstalker, and it did not matter. The one death that cost was at 20, to Kira, an outer tower falling after.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Shinbi played a clean offlane. Four kills, zero deaths, nine assists, 33,949 damage to heroes and 37,671 mitigated, with no armor against four physical damage dealers and it never cost a death. He was the third body in the fight at 14.5, won 5-0, and the fight at 21.9, won 3-0.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Renna won mid outright against a read that said otherwise. Ten kills, two deaths, 11 assists and Howitzer killed three times on his way to 3-7-1. The two deaths were the coin-flip at 3.7 and the fight at 24 with Yin, lost 0-2, which cost an outer tower. He closed the game alone: two kills at 31.7, then the core.

219ccde6-c9e2-4a6e-900c-65304c72c960.text: Three deaths before minute 11 gave away the Fangtooth; first blood and 32,850 objective damage bought it back.

7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.text: In on 29 of 38 kills with the most healing and wards in the game; the two early deaths are the only note.

29199160-1218-49ea-9f15-0717d1726afb.text: Fifteen kills on two deaths and Kira killed six times; the lane read was wrong and he proved it.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.text: Zero deaths, four kills, nine assists and 37,671 mitigated; nothing to fix here.

a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.text: Ten kills to two deaths and Howitzer killed three times; mid was won by 13 and the game closed alone at 31.7.

14.5.call: The fight to copy: at Fangtooth, won 5-0 with Legion and Yin taking two kills each, then Fangtooth and an outer tower inside a minute. Fight on the objective with everyone up, then take it.

27.1.call: Killing three across the map while Orb Prime walks away is a trade, not a plan, and Primal Fangtooth at 28 made it even. The miss is awareness: nobody was dead, so the Orb was a choice. Ward it.

28.9.call: Won 4-2, and the inner tower and inhibitor fell within a minute. Right call. The note is Legion dying to Howitzer at 29.2 with the fight already won.

219ccde6-c9e2-4a6e-900c-65304c72c960.build: Four damage items and no armor against four physical damage dealers, and it showed: 60,932 damage taken, with Bayle killing him three times. Terminus and Imperator gave burst; the skipped Sky Splitter deals current-health damage on hit, the same job into Bayle with a slot left for armor.
219ccde6-c9e2-4a6e-900c-65304c72c960.eternal: Vermis pays on the third consecutive basic on one hero, which is what Yin's Lash Kick into Windburn basics produces on an isolated target.

7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.build: Marshal, Enra's Blessing and Galaxy Greaves all done; on core, nothing to teach here.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.eternal: The engine does not model support Eternals; the field runs Exarch on Phase, which is attack speed on Legion every time the link heals him.

29199160-1218-49ea-9f15-0717d1726afb.build: Off the core and it won the lane: Vanquisher's execute and Tainted Rounds' healing cut against Adele produced 15 kills, so Malady and Deathstalker are the note only for a harder lineup.
29199160-1218-49ea-9f15-0717d1726afb.eternal: Vermis fits a marksman whose damage is repeated basics on one target, with Melting Point adding damage against heavily armored targets, the frontline he had to shoot through.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.build: Five ability-power items and no armor against a four-physical lineup, and zero deaths says the lineup never tested it; nothing to teach here.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.eternal: Vesh with The Tenth Seal and Mind Rot fits a wolves-and-dashes kit whose damage is all abilities, adding a burn to each Line Tempo hit and a stronger All-Kill! after level 10.

a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.build: Entropy, Wraith Leggings and Overseer with Oblivion Crown and Caustica on top; on core, nothing to teach here.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.eternal: Vesh suits Renna because Soulfire and Mortal Coil are ability damage that lands repeatedly, and Mind Rot adds a slice of current health on each hit for a zone mage who wins the long fight.

in on 29 of 38 kills, most healing and wards in the game
first blood and top objective damage, but five deaths, three before minute 11

threats: Chain-CC risk (2 hard-CC abilities, ~1.0s of lockdown): Howitzer Land Mine (knockback), Bayle Kingslayer (knockback). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Adele. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 2 items of it.
Enemy is 4/5 physical — a single armor item blunts most of their damage; itemize armor on anyone diveable.
synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
We have sustain (Phase) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Lash Kick gap-close+slow → Windburn %hp basics → Backlash push, Quelling Gale to disengage
ourKits.passive: Rising Storm stacks grant attack speed
ourKits.playWith: a team that lets her side-lane and pick
ourKits.playAgainst: she wants 1v1s — group and burst her; Quelling Gale only stops projectiles

ourKits.combo: Telekinetic Link an ally → Psychic Flare blind → Energy Lance → Hyperflux buff ult
ourKits.winCondition: buff a hyper-carry through the Link and Hyperflux for a teamfight
ourKits.passive: abilities heal her and her linked ally
ourKits.playWith: the strongest carry to Link and supercharge
ourKits.playAgainst: kill the linked carry, not Phase; break the link timing

ourKits.combo: Rushing Beat dashes → Line Tempo wolves → Circle Rhythm shield → All-Kill! wolfpack ult
ourKits.winCondition: stack Track and unleash All-Kill! in a grouped fight
ourKits.playAgainst: spread vs the wolfpack; she's squishy without her shield up

ourKits.combo: Soulfire waves → Mortal Coil pull-zone → Stupor orb → Abyssal Rift zone
ourKits.winCondition: zone a fight with Mortal Coil + ult and chunk from range
ourKits.passive: consumes essences from kills for power
ourKits.playWith: frontline to hold enemies in her zones
ourKits.playAgainst: fragile and reliant on her zones — flank/dive around the telegraphs

enemyKits.combo: Slow Grenades / Land Mine zone → R2000 Missile → Make It Rain ult
enemyKits.winCondition: wall off space with mines/grenades and rain artillery on a held enemy
enemyKits.playWith: CC and chokes that force enemies into his zones
enemyKits.playAgainst: immobile turret — flank his mine zones, dive when ult is down

enemyKits.combo: Skull Crusher gap-close → Dire Howl slow → Cursed Edge → Kingslayer knockback dash, Berserk at low HP
enemyKits.winCondition: engage, drop low into Berserk and out-brawl
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up while he commits the dive
enemyKits.playAgainst: his Berserk rewards low HP — burst him fully or disengage; anti-heal helps

enemyKits.combo: Mercy poke → stack Vengeance → Shadow Glide reposition → Purge ult
enemyKits.winCondition: stack Vengeance and shred with the channeled Purge
enemyKits.playWith: peel so she can channel Purge safely
enemyKits.playAgainst: interrupt/CC her during Purge; punish her short dash cooldown

bayle.loadout: Xyris (Dominance + Bone Collector), augment Betrayer's Reqiuem, crest Judgement
fedBy: Malady (Demise): On damaging a Hero below 40% Health: Deal 20 (+15%) Damage.• Gain a stack of Demise.• Damage increases by 4 per stack of Demise.• Takedowns reset the Cooldown.
Dominance (minor): Takedowns heal you for 100 (+15% Missing Health).
lines: Kingslayer at top rank: 115s base, about 78.8s by the end (31% shorter) from 46 ability haste: Augmentation 20, Malady 8, Tainted Blade 10, Tainted Guard 8.
6 takedowns (4 kills, 2 assists) fed: Malady (Demise), Dominance (minor).
Their build heals off damage: anti-heal (the Tainted items) cuts it.
Bayle dealt 13,507 hero damage, 14% of their team's, with +137 physical power from items.

Penetration: Malady 11; against Yin (level 17 estimated: about 93 physical armor, 82 after penetration) and Phase (level 17 estimated: about 170 physical armor, 159 after penetration) that is about 6% and 4% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Augmentation (item): On Ability Cast: Empower your next Basic Attack within 4s. Deal (+90% Base Physical Power) Damage On-Hit.
Malady (item): On damaging a Hero below 40% Health: Deal 20 (+15%) Damage. Gain a stack of Demise. Damage increases by 4 per stack of Demise. Takedowns reset the Cooldown.
Tainted Blade (item): On dealing Physical Damage: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s.
Tainted Blade (item): On dealing Ability Damage to a Blighted Target: Cause them to take 5% more damage for 3s.
Tainted Guard (item): On being hit by a Basic Attack: Reduce the Source's Healing by 45% for 3s. Apply a Bleed dealing 30 (+30%) Damage over 3s.
Judgement (crest): Deal 70 (+40%) Damage in an area around you. On Hero hit, Heal (+30%) (+8%). Subsequent Hero hits Heal for 50% effectiveness.
Xyris (Eternal): Deal 3% bonus damage, increased by 0.4% per 10 units killed, up to 400 units.

Sustain: 4% omnivamp; Tainted Blade: On dealing Physical Damage: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s.; Tainted Guard: On being hit by a Basic Attack: Reduce the Source's Healing by 45% for 3s. Apply a Bleed dealing 30 (+30%) Damage over 3s.; Judgement: Deal 70 (+40%) Damage in an area around you. On Hero hit, Heal (+30%) (+8%). Subsequent Hero hits Heal for 50% effectiveness.; Dominance: Takedowns heal you for 100 (+15% Missing Health).; 18,218 healing recorded.
Toughness: +825 health, +55 physical armor; took 53,605 damage, mitigated 32,277, died 9 times.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 4 effects on one trigger: Tainted Blade, Tainted Guard, Judgement, Dominance.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 2 effects on one trigger: Augmentation, Tainted Guard.
Stack (Every takedown fed): 2 effects on one trigger: Malady, Dominance. Each kill or assist made the next fight easier.
The Eternal was part of it: Xyris (Dominance + Bone Collector) sits on the same triggers as the items (healing off the damage; every takedown fed), so the same hits paid out twice.
Countered? 1 of the 2 players Bayle killed built physical armor (Phase). Anti-heal on Legion, Shinbi. We killed Bayle 9 times.
Copy it? Xyris: 44.7% in 304 Bayle jungle games, level with the hero's 45.2%. A standard setup: what made it work was this game, not a secret build.

card.lesson: Kingslayer came back about every 79s instead of 115s by the end (31% shorter). Count it, and take fights while it is down.

phase.loadout: Exarch (Preservation + Fervour), augment Psychic Support, crest Tranquility
lines: Lead story: Healed through fights. 794 healing a minute, more than 93% of Phase support players this patch.
Hyperflux at top rank: 85s base, about 56.7s by the end (33% shorter) from 50 ability haste: Marshal 15, Enra's Blessing 15, Galaxy Greaves 10, Vanguardian 10.
Phase dealt 16,768 hero damage, 12% of their team's, with +130 magical power from items.
Tranquility (crest): Heal yourself and nearby Heroes by 150 (+70%). Also grant 10% Damage Mitigation for 2s.
